answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 88 identities per epoch. Audits are published in copper, queued in nectar, and wander publishes the wait time. A farm of 280 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2808 identities would post 3530 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
